notes: AWC DCA 6, a guide on the 2015 IRC, declared by the Connecticut 2022 pack for its deck tables only (docs/design/deck-guide-pack.md). It is not Connecticut's adopted code (CT 2022 adopts the 2021 IRC). Every text below is verbatim from the PDF named in sources (sha256 checked 2026-09-27), with where it is printed; an ellipsis joins two verbatim passages. Transcribed 2026-09-27: Table 2 (#41 slice B1) and Table 3A, p. 6, with the two beam notes from p. 5 (#41 slice B2); not yet reviewed (docs/code-packs/reviews/us-ct-2022/dca6-table2.md, dca6-table3a.md).

guide.title: Prescriptive Residential Wood Deck Construction Guide, Based on the 2015 International Residential Code

caveats.text: Based on the 2015 International Residential Code
Where differences exist between provisions of this document and the IRC, provisions of the IRC shall apply.

limits.text: Assumes 40 psf live load, 10 psf dead load, No. 2 grade, and wet service conditions. … Decks supporting large concentrated loads such as hot tubs are beyond the scope of this document.
limits.location: Table 2 note 1, p. 4; MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS & LIMITATIONS item 8, p. 2

limits.text: This document does not apply to decks which will experience snow loads, snow drift loads, or sliding snow loads that exceed 40 psf.
Overall deck length shall be equal to or less than overall deck width. See DECK FRAMING PLAN for definition of deck length and width.
limits.location: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS & LIMITATIONS item 2, p. 2; DECK FRAMING PLAN and Figure 5, p. 8

notes.text: This document applies to single level residential wood decks that are attached to the house to resist lateral forces. [R507.2.4]
Stairs and stair landings shall not be included in determining the overall deck length or width.

All lumber and glued laminated timber shall be a naturally durable species (such as Redwood or Western Cedars where 90 percent or more of the width of each side is heartwood); or be preservatively treated with an approved process in accordance with American Wood Protection Association standards (Table 1) [R317 and R318].
notes.location: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS & LIMITATIONS item 4, p. 2; Table 1, p. 3

notes.text: Deck beam spans shall be in accordance with Table 3 and can extend past the post face up to LB/4 as shown in Figure 3.
notes.location: BEAM SIZE & ASSEMBLY REQUIREMENTS, p. 5; Figure 3, p. 7

notes.text: Joists shall not frame in from opposite sides of the same beam. See JOIST-TO-BEAM CONNECTION details, Figure 6.
